pertanyaan: How does a computer network connect to a server?
sumber_top1: Informatika untuk SMP/MTs Kelas VIII (Edisi Revisi), Tabel Logika Gerbang Sirkui
jawaban: A computer network connects to a server through a link, which is the path of data transmission between two nodes [1]. The nodes themselves are the points or devices that generate input data or receive it, and examples of nodes in a network are computers, laptops, phones, switches, and routers [1]. The link is the connection between one node and another, and sometimes it is also called an edge [1]. Switches and routers are the hardware components of a network that connect devices to one another using switching packets, and the difference between them is that a switch can only connect devices on the same network, while a router can connect devices from two different networks [1]. A router uses routing tables to determine the best path for a packet of data being sent from one device to another, and the book illustrates this with a diagram of a network that only connects two devices and one that connects more than two [1][3]. The book also notes that a network is built from hardware and software, and that each device connected to a network has a unique address called an IP address [1].

pertanyaan: What is a magnet and how does it work?
sumber_top1: Ilmu Pengetahuan alam Kelas IX Semester 2, Petunjuk Penggunaan Buku › 6Kemagneta
jawaban: A magnet is a material that can attract other objects, and it has two poles: a north pole and a south pole [1]. The force of a magnet comes from the interaction between those poles of other magnets, and the book explains it through the movement of the charged particles inside the material, the elementary magnets that make it up [1]. The book also notes that the same pole of two magnets will repel each other, while different poles will attract [1]. The book shows this with an experiment: place a bar magnet on a piece of cork and float it on water, and the end pointing north is the north pole of the magnet, while the end pointing south is the south pole [1]. You can also make a magnet yourself, for example by rubbing a bar magnet along a nail or a piece of iron, or by using induction, which is bringing a magnet close to a nail or a piece of iron [1]. The book also lists three groups of materials based on how strongly they attract a magnet: feromagnetic materials, such as iron and steel, which are pulled strongly; paramagnetic materials, such as magnesium, molybdenum, and lithium, which are pulled weakly; and diamagnetic materials, such as silver, gold, copper, and bismut, which are not pulled at all [1].

The five values are the foundation of how the Indonesian people see and understand the world, and that is why it is called the national outlook [1]. In practice, Pancasila is meant to be realised by all Indonesians through understanding, appreciation, and embodiment in daily life [1]. The book also places it in the context of the nation's history, as the crystallization of experience in the long history of the Indonesian people who have formed the character, the behaviour, the ethics, the values, and the norms that are the national outlook [1].

pertanyaan: What is the difference between fact and opinion?
sumber_top1: Bahasa Indonesia Kelas XII, dalam Sebuah Artikel yang Dibaca! › Kegiatan1
jawaban: A fact is a reality or an event that really exists or happened [1]. It usually answers the questions what, who, when, where, or how many, and it is something that can be verified [1]. An opinion, on the other hand, is a person's view, thought, or stance towards something, and it usually answers the questions how and why [1]. The book gives a concrete example: the editorial text you read is a piece of writing about a problem, including the writer's opinion of that problem, and it is meant to persuade, educate, or entertain the reader [2]. In that text, the facts are the events and the data related to the event that is discussed, while the opinions are the judgements, criticisms, predictions, hopes, and suggestions for solving the problem that the editorial's argument is built on [3]. A key thing is that a fact is hard to deny because it can be seen, heard, or known by many people, while an opinion is still open to debate [3].

pertanyaan: What is the internet used for?
sumber_top1: Informatika untuk SMP/MTs Kelas VIII (Edisi Revisi), Tabel Logika Gerbang Sirkui
jawaban:
The internet is a network of computer networks that spans a country or even the whole world, and it is an abbreviation of Inter-Network [1]. It is used for communication, for example email, chat, discussion through Usenet News and email, for accessing distributed information such as the World Wide Web and Gopher, for remote login, and for file transfer [1]. The protocol that runs this network globally is TCP/IP, which is also called the Switching Communication Protocol [1]. The book also puts the user side of that protocol into a client application, and it notes that a computer needs three things to be connected: hardware support, software support, and a registration with an Internet Service Provider (ISP) [1].

jawaban: Social harmony is defined as the condition in which the parts or components of a society unite and work together [1]. It can also be seen as a shared aspiration for peace, when the social system in a society functions well without conflict or disintegration [1]. The book places it alongside other concepts such as integration, inclusion, and cohesion as the principles for building harmony in society [1]. Social harmony is not only a desirable state, it is also a practical need, since a society that works together against inequality and injustice is one that can maintain unity [1]. The book gives family, institutions, the nation, antarnegara (relations between countries), and even the individual's relationship with nature as the scope of social harmony, and it runs through political, economic, cultural, legal, and social life [1].
